messages:
Omar: Quick heads-up I'm putting up a small PR to add a 'per-route prefetch' example and a metrics checklist to the Optimize toolkit docs. Aim: make it clear when to flip prefetch per route vs change quant profile. PR: https://git.internal/redwood/docs/pulls/9201
Lydia: Love this. Can we show an explicit per-route override in both JS and Python? people copy-paste that into their routes.
Pablo: Also add a short note about prefetch window (prefetch.window_ms) — by default it's tuned for long requests and can hurt streaming. Recommend example values 0/10/50ms.
Anika: Please include a tiny troubleshooting table: symptom -> metric to check -> quick action. e.g. "stream stalls" -> check redwood.stream_sse_lag and redwood.kv_prefetch_miss_rate -> action: set prefetch.enabled=false for streaming route or set max_batch_ms=0.
Omar: Draft JS per-route snippet I'm adding:
```js
// per-route prefetch override
await client.generate({
  model: 'rwd-3',
  input: 'short prompt',
  prefetch: { enabled: false, window_ms: 0 }
});
```
Pablo: And py example please:
```python
# per-request override
resp = client.generate(model='rwd-3', input='x', prefetch={'enabled': False, 'window_ms': 10})
```
Lydia: Add a curl + jq example to pull the three key metrics (stream_p95_latency, kv_prefetch_miss_rate, batch_effective_size) so SREs can copy/paste:
```bash
curl -s -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \
  "https://console.redwood.ai/api/metrics?names=stream_p95_latency,kv_prefetch_miss_rate,batch_effective_size&range=5m" | jq .
```
Anika: Small editorial: avoid "turn off prefetch" alone; show the exact config keys and explain effect. Also add a one-line caution that toggling prefetch may temporarily increase p95 while caches warm.
docs-bot: @Omar scheduled link-check + snippet-lint on PR open. Will flag internal-only URLs.
Pablo: One extra troubleshooting tip: if kv_prefetch_miss_rate ticks up after switching quant, suggest toggling prefetch.window_ms up by 10-50ms and re-measuring before changing quant. Put that in the short recipe.
Omar: Good. I'll add a short 3-step recipe: 1) per-route prefetch=false for streaming 2) if OOMs/low throughput, compare q profiles 3) if misses remain, bump prefetch.window_ms or increase capacity. ETA: pushing in ~45m and will ping for review. :v:
